contract.prior: boundary t-1 -> t uses filtered state/context at t-1, before observing x_t
contract.updated: same edge Bayes-updated with emission at x_t; no future observations
contract.matching: post-fit maximum-cardinality one-to-one state-boundary matching within 5 rows
contract.labels: scoring/grouping only; no training or decoder/budget selection
contract.age: age-one is episode-reset mass since D=64; D+ bucket caps reported age mean
contract.threshold: .5 is descriptive only, not an operational policy
contract.sums: sums of online one-edge probabilities with different information sets; not a common full-window posterior expected path count
